svg.title: same-names-a: Logo/Bogo/Fogo are this document's fonts, not B's
svg.text: Same CSS names as same-names-b.svg (Logo, Bogo, Fogo). Each document binds those names to different files.
Pass: this window is script / spooky / geometric. B must stay pixel / brush / blackletter.
Fail: A and B look the same, or these samples match the sans captions. Font dialog will not list Logo.
